question: Please help me identify the top 3 bowlers who, in the overs where the maximum runs were conceded in each match, gave up the highest number of runs in a single over across all matches. For each of these bowlers, provide the match in which they conceded these maximum runs. Only consider overs that had the most runs conceded within their respective matches, and among these, determine which bowlers conceded the most runs in a single over overall.
pred_sql:
WITH -- compute runs per ball joined
 ball_runs AS (
  SELECT
    bb.match_id,
    bb.over_id,
    bb.ball_id,
    bb.bowler,
    bs.runs_scored
  FROM ball_by_ball bb
  JOIN batsman_scored bs
    ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id
   AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id
   AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
   AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
 ),

 -- total runs conceded by each bowler in each over (within a match)
 over_runs AS (
  SELECT
    match_id,
    over_id,
    bowler,
    SUM(runs_scored) AS runs_in_over
  FROM ball_runs
  GROUP BY match_id, over_id, bowler
 ),

 -- for each match find the maximum runs conceded in any over (could be by any bowler/over)
 match_max_over AS (
  SELECT
    match_id,
    MAX(runs_in_over) AS max_runs_in_match
  FROM over_runs
  GROUP BY match_id
 ),

 -- keep only the overs in each match that have that match-level maximum
 match_max_overs AS (
  SELECT
    o.match_id,
    o.over_id,
    o.bowler,
    o.runs_in_over
  FROM over_runs o
  JOIN match_max_over mm
    ON o.match_id = mm.match_id
   AND o.runs_in_over = mm.max_runs_in_match
 ),

 -- now find, across all those selected overs (each match's most-conceded over(s)), the top 3 bowlers by their single-over runs and include the match
 top3 AS (
  SELECT
    mmo.bowler,
    mmo.match_id,
    mmo.runs_in_over
  FROM match_max_overs mmo
  ORDER BY mmo.runs_in_over DESC
  LIMIT 3
 )

SELECT
  p.player_name AS bowler_name,
  t.match_id,
  t.runs_in_over AS runs_conceded_in_over
FROM top3 t
JOIN player p ON p.player_id = t.bowler
ORDER BY t.runs_in_over DESC, p.player_name

question: Which bowler has the lowest bowling average per wicket taken?
pred_sql:
WITH wickets AS (
    -- count wickets taken by each bowler
    SELECT 
        wt.player_out AS placeholder, -- not used
        bbb.bowler AS bowler_id,
        COUNT(*) AS wickets_taken
    FROM 
        wicket_taken AS wt
    JOIN 
        ball_by_ball AS bbb
    ON 
        wt.match_id = bbb.match_id
        AND wt.over_id = bbb.over_id
        AND wt.ball_id = bbb.ball_id
        AND wt.innings_no = bbb.innings_no
    GROUP BY 
        bbb.bowler
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
),
runs_conceded AS (
    -- sum runs conceded by each bowler (batsman runs + extras) using ball mapping
    SELECT
        bbb.bowler AS bowler_id,
        SUM(
            IFNULL(bs.runs_scored,0) + IFNULL(er.extra_runs,0)
        ) AS runs_conceded
    FROM
        ball_by_ball AS bbb
    LEFT JOIN
        batsman_scored AS bs
    ON
        bbb.match_id = bs.match_id
        AND bbb.over_id = bs.over_id
        AND bbb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        AND bbb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN
        extra_runs AS er
    ON
        bbb.match_id = er.match_id
        AND bbb.over_id = er.over_id
        AND bbb.ball_id = er.ball_id
        AND bbb.innings_no = er.innings_no
    GROUP BY
        bbb.bowler
),
bowling_stats AS (
    SELECT
        r.bowler_id,
        r.runs_conceded,
        w.wickets_taken,
        CASE WHEN w.wickets_taken > 0 THEN CAST(r.runs_conceded AS FLOAT)/w.wickets_taken END AS bowling_avg
    FROM
        runs_conceded r
    JOIN
        wickets w ON r.bowler_id = w.bowler_id
    WHERE
        w.wickets_taken > 0
)
SELECT
    p.player_name,
    bs.bowling_avg
FROM
    bowling_stats bs
JOIN
    player p ON bs.bowler_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY
    bs.bowling_avg ASC
LIMIT 1
